description: Ex-RAF Harrier GR.3; construction number 712230 (per AirHistory); photographed operationally with No. 1417 Flight at Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport on 5 Aug 1997 by Jonathan Verschuuren. Left behind in Belize and recorded as a survivor on display: Thunder & Lightnings' Harrier register lists it under "Belize City; Belize" (entry updated 1 Apr 2018) and laststandonzombieisland (2023) places it "on display at Ladyville". Earlier in its RAF life it diverted to RAF Leeming after a birdstrike and was repaired and flown to RAF Wittering c.1991 (PPRuNe; IV(AC) Sqn recollection); so it did not remain continuously in Belize. Condition; ownership; paint scheme and exact siting are all unverified. Wikipedia's RAF Belize; Price Barracks and Hawker Siddeley Harrier articles contain NO mention of it. Aircraft is a GR.3 — the last-built batch of GR.3s carried ZD66x serials.
